articles.summary: MOUNTLAKE TERRACE, Wash., June 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- FS Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: FSBW), the holding company for 1st Security Bank of Washington (“1st Security Bank” or “Bank”), announced today that it has named Matthew D. Mullet CEO of the Company, effective June 1, 2026.
articles.title: FS Bancorp, Inc. Names Matt Mullet CEO
